svg.title: Drosophila chromosome complements
svg.desc: Each panel shows eight chromosomes as single rods at the same schematic scale: pairs 2, 3 and 4 with XX on the left and XY on the right. Pale collars mark centromeres and carry chromosome IDs. The X and Y centromeres are nearly level, with the Y short arm facing the proximal X heterochromatin to suggest their rDNA pairing at metaphase I. Teal on the arms marks heterochromatin.
